interface.name: kywc_workspace_manager_v1
interface.description:
Workspaces, also called virtual desktops, are groups of surfaces. A compositor with a concept of workspaces may only show some such groups of surfaces (those of 'active' workspaces) at a time. 'Activating' a workspace is a request for the compositor to display that workspace's surfaces as normal, whereas the compositor may hide or otherwise de-emphasise surfaces that are associated only with 'inactive' workspaces.
After a client binds the kywc_workspace_manager_v1, each workspace will be sent via the workspace event.

event.name: workspace
event.description:
This event is emitted whenever a new workspace has been created.
All initial details of the workspace (name, position, activated) will be sent immediately after this event via the corresponding events in kywc_workspace_v1.

request.name: create_workspace
request.description:
Request that the compositor create a new workspace with the given name and position it at a specified position.
If the position is zero or less, it will be positioned at the beginning, if the position is the count or more, it will be positioned at the end.
There is no guarantee that the compositor will create a new workspace, or that the created workspace will have the provided name and position.

arg.name: name
arg.summary: the user readable name we want

arg.name: position
arg.summary: the position we want for the workspace

event.name: done

description.summary: all information about the workspaces has been sent

event.description:
This event is sent after all changes in all workspaces have been sent.
This allows changes to one or more kywc_workspace_v1 properties to be seen as atomic, even if they happen via multiple events.

event.name: finished

description.summary: the compositor has finished with the workspace_manager

event.description: This event indicates that the compositor is done sending events to the kywc_workspace_manager_v1. The server will destroy the object immediately after sending this request, so it will become invalid and the client should free any resources associated with it.

request.name: stop
request.description:
Indicates the client no longer wishes to receive events for new workspace. However the compositor may emit further workspace events, until the finished event is emitted. The compositor is expected to send the finished event eventually once the stop request has been processed.
The client must not send any more requests after this one.

interface.name: kywc_workspace_v1

description.summary: a workspace handing a group of surfaces

interface.description:
A kywc_workspace_v1 object represents a workspace that handles a group of surfaces.
Each workspace has a name, conveyed to the client with the name event; and a position, conveyed to the client with the position event. The client may request that the compositor activate or deactivate the workspace.

event.name: name
event.description: This event is emitted immediately after the kywc_workspace_v1 is created and whenever the name of the workspace changes.

event.name: activated
event.description: The workspace will be the new "current" workspace of the system.

event.name: deactivated

description.summary: this workspace is no longer active

event.description: surfaces that were associated only to this workspace will be hidden.

event.name: removed
event.description: This event means the kywc_workspace_v1 has been destroyed. It is guaranteed there won't be any more events for this kywc_workspace_v1. The kywc_workspace_v1 becomes inert so any requests will be ignored except the destroy request.

request.name: destroy
request.description:
Destroys the kywc_workspace_v1 object.
This request should be called either when the client does not want to use the workspace object any more or after the remove event to finalize the destruction of the object.

request.name: set_position
request.description: If the position is zero or less, it will be positioned at the beginning, if the position is the count or more, it will be positioned at the end.

arg.name: position
arg.summary: the position we want for the workspace

request.name: activate
request.description:
Request that this workspace be activated.
There is no guarantee the workspace will be actually activated, and behaviour may be compositor-dependentption

request.name: remove
request.description:
Request that this workspace be removed.
There is no guarantee the workspace will be actually removed.
